name: voice-agent-backend
description: FastAPI backend: Agno AgentOS text chat, plus the token, tool-relay and LLM-proxy endpoints the AssemblyAI voice agent needs.

PROJECT_PATH.description: Deploy the backend/ subdirectory. The repo root holds a package.json for the frontend, which would otherwise be detected instead, and a stale pyproject.toml missing psycopg, pgvector, composio and httpx.

ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY.description: AssemblyAI key for the Voice Agent API. Never reaches the browser.

LLM_PROXY_SECRET.description: Shared secret sent as the llm[].api_key and checked on arrival, so the public proxy endpoint isn't open. Any long random string.
